title: Clark the Shark
author: Bruce Hale
intro: Clark the Shark is the biggest and strongest fish at Theodore Roosterfish Elementary. He loves school, his friends, and his teacher!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What kind of animal is Clark?
questions.clue: His name is Clark the Shark.
questions.yes: Clark is a big, strong shark.

questions.q: Where does Clark go every day?
questions.clue: He loves his teacher and his classmates there.
questions.yes: Clark goes to Theodore Roosterfish Elementary.

questions.q: Who is Clark's teacher at school?
Who is Clark's best friend at school?
questions.yes: Joey Mackerel is Clark's best friend.

questions.q: Why do the other fish stop playing with Clark?
questions.clue: He is too loud and plays too hard for the smaller fish.
questions.yes: The other fish stop playing with Clark because he plays too rough.

questions.q: What rule does Mrs. Inkydink give Clark to help him behave?
questions.clue: The two words mean to stay calm, and the second word is cool.
questions.yes: Mrs. Inkydink tells Clark that the rule is to stay cool.

questions.q: What does Clark accidentally do on the playground when he forgets the rule?

options.text: He pushes the swing too hard

questions.clue: Joey Mackerel is sitting on it when Clark pushes it too hard.
questions.yes: Clark forgets and pushes the swing much too hard.

questions.q: What does Clark do at lunchtime when he forgets the rule?

options.text: He throws food across the lunchroom

questions.clue: Everything smells so good that he munches a bunch of them.
questions.yes: Clark forgets and munches a bunch of his friends' lunches.

questions.q: What does Clark start making up to help himself remember the rules?
questions.clue: He notices that rule and cool sound the same at the end.
questions.yes: Clark makes up rhymes to help himself remember every time.

questions.q: Why does Clark say a rhyme when lessons get exciting in class?
questions.clue: He tells himself not to go walking when the teacher is talking.
questions.yes: Clark uses a rhyme to stay in his seat when lessons get exciting.

questions.q: How does Clark feel when his rhymes work and his friends play with him?
questions.clue: He smiles and grins because lunch and playtime are fun again.
questions.yes: Clark feels happy when his friends let him play again.

questions.q: Who is the giant new kid with tentacles?
questions.clue: He is a squid whose name rhymes with squid.
questions.yes: The giant new kid is Sid the Squid.

questions.q: How do Joey Mackerel and the other fish feel when they first see Sid?
questions.clue: Joey Mackerel shouts that the new kid looks scary.
questions.yes: Joey Mackerel and the other fish feel scared of Sid at first.

questions.q: Where does Sid the Squid meet Clark and the other fish?
questions.clue: It is outside where the slide and the swings are.
questions.yes: Sid meets them outside on the school playground.

questions.q: Why does Clark swim over to play hard with Sid the Squid?
questions.clue: Clark tells his friends that the new kid just wants to play.
questions.yes: Clark plays with Sid because Sid just wants to play.
